lead.description: summaries and fits that barely move when a small fraction of the data is moved a long way

self_checks.title: Absolute deviations
self_checks.prompt: For 1, 2, 3, 4 and 20, what are the sums of absolute deviations from the mean 6 and from the median 3?
self_checks.answer: The sums are 28 at the mean and 21 at the median.

self_checks.title: Squared deviations
self_checks.prompt: For the same five numbers, what are the sums of squared deviations from 6 and from 3?
self_checks.answer: The sums are 250 at the mean and 295 at the median.

self_checks.title: One wild point
self_checks.prompt: For 5, 5, 5, 5 and 100, what are the mean and the sum of absolute deviations from the median?
self_checks.answer: The mean is 24 and the sum of absolute deviations from the median 5 is 95.

overview_sentence: [Robust statistics](articles/robust-statistics.qmd) are summaries that resist a few extreme observations.
